title: PaCo-VLA: Passivity-Shielded Compliance Prior for Contact-Rich Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2606.00515v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation demands both high-level semantic reasoning and the safe regulation of high-frequency contact dynamics. While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide unprecedented semantic generalization, their low-rate outputs lack the reliability required for direct plant authority in force-sensitive tasks. To bridge this semantic-to-control gap, we introduce PaCo-VLA, a passivity-shielded compliance prior that recasts the VLA interface. Rather than trusting VLAs with direct motor commands, PaCo-VLA treats network outputs as task-level compliance proposals: semantic bindings, task stages, and admittance schedules. A high-frequency, proposal-independent passivity shield governs these proposals through energy-tank accounting and boundary checks, preventing invalid, stale, or unverified model predictions from bypassing low-level contact physics. translated_title: PaCo-VLA：面向接触密集型视觉-语言-动作操作的被动性屏蔽柔顺先验
translated_abstract: 接触密集型操作既需要高层语义推理，也需要对高频接触动力学进行安全调控。虽然视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型提供了前所未有的语义泛化能力，但其低频率的输出缺乏在力敏感任务中直接控制执行机构所需的可靠性。为了弥合这一从语义到控制的鸿沟，我们提出了PaCo-VLA，一种被动性屏蔽的柔顺先验，重新定义了VLA的接口。PaCo-VLA并不信任VLA直接输出电机指令，而是将网络输出视为任务级的柔顺提议：语义绑定、任务阶段和导纳调度。一个高频的、与提议无关的被动性屏蔽通过能量罐核算和边界检查来管理这些提议，防止无效、过时或未经验证的模型预测绕过低层接触物理。这种解耦架构还支持因果评估，将……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PaCo-VLA的核心创新在于将VLA模型的输出从直接电机指令重新定义为任务级柔顺提议（语义绑定、任务阶段与导纳调度），并通过高频、与提议无关的被动性屏蔽（能量罐核算与边界检查）保障接触密集型操作的安全性与可靠性。
en_tdlr: PaCo-VLA recasts VLA outputs as task-level compliance proposals (semantic bindings, task stages, and admittance schedules) instead of direct motor commands, and uses a high-frequency, proposal-independent passivity shield with energy-tank accounting and boundary checks to ensure safe and reliable contact-rich manipulation.
